profile.headline: Software Engineer at Sitewire
profile.summary: Hi, I’m Cam! I’m a developer who enjoys the complexities of problem solving in a dynamic environment and the fast paced nature of engineering. I am always eager for new challenges and the opportunity to grow both as a developer and professional. I’m a kind, personable, and passionate individual who works well with others (but also loves making time for heads down development). I am a full stack developer that has experience contributing to the entirety of the development lifecycle.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my current role my team prides itself in taking on complex high priority projects. Of note I:
- Developed an automated scheduling service for our customer to use for managing technician field appointments. This project spanned the entire development cycle but I’m primarily proud of the assignment automation. It allows users to minimize work on their end by determining the technician that will be the closest and most qualified for each new appointment. Efficient and organized data base structure, backend computation, and querying were some of the most important consideration in this project and areas I spent significant time in. I also introduced powerful frontend logic and a meaningful UI.
- Expanded our provisioning service. In the field, technicians have to do lots of manual work to provide internet for customers. This used to include manually entering information in multiple places and communication with customer service to get a customer’s internet online. Now with the touch of a button technicians can complete the entire workflow and users have powerful features to manage device status, changing equipment, and updating customer’s service. This alleviated two frequent bottlenecks in our industry:  installing new internet services and altering existing customer’s hardware. This work was very api heavy as we communicate with outside software that manages providing internet service to customers. It was also a project where I worked directly with customers to better understand their needs and design a solution that was meaningful to the end user.
- Created customized email templating. Giving users the ability to design fully custom email templates for different workflows allows the business to bring on new clients more easily and gives our customers the ability to more uniquely connect with each of their users. This was a heavy full stack project that included complex UI for template creation and thorough backend logic for event handling and email generation.

positions.title: Jr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Junior Developer I prioritized growth and opportunity. I quickly grew into a full stack developer and go to person for challenging tickets, code reviews, and debugging. I focused on being well rounded and contributing in every way possible. My role began with heads down development on appropriate frontend and backend work and blossomed to include the entire development lifecycle. 

Highlights include:
- Launching a powerful assets tracking service allowing our customers to more accurately track equipment. In this project I was able to contribute to the entire development lifecycle. I participated in design review and ticket creation, then did a significant portion of data modeling and backend development. I also contributed to UI enhancements and wrote testing to prevent bug deployment. I began reviewing pull requests at this time which was crucial for balancing work load throughout the team and allowed our lead developer more time to develop.
- The automation of a job to dump production data and replace our staging instance with a clean up to data database copy on a weekly basis. This greatly improved the speed and efficiency of QA testing reducing the number of deployment bugs.
